body:
Labels and checkboxes have a very specific behavior on clicks so we do not handle them when multiple level deep.

There is no point in using checkboxes for the hierarchical menu. In a menu you NEED links so that you can cooy paste the href and ctrl click to open in a new tab.

It will in the end look weird to you users to have a hidden checkbox just to avoid having a different template.

You have two different UI element, you need a different template here.
